name: AI Supply Chain Compromise
description: Compromise of the models, datasets, packages, plugins or MCP servers an AI system assembles from — including published poisoned artefacts and reputation/rug-pull attacks on agent tools.
differs: Distinguished from Tool and Context Poisoning (T3.002), which manipulates a tool's metadata or results at runtime; here the artefact itself is compromised before or during acquisition.
